races.verdict: TEOFIL showed a good attitude to make his second bumper outing a winning one at Galway last month, despite his rider reporting the saddle slipped, and looks the one to beat under a penalty. Emergency Man bumped into one that's gone in again since on his debut here 5 weeks ago and can provide the main threat, ahead of Rokanako , who's already been beaten under a penalty. TEOFIL (IRE) EMERGENCY MAN (IRE) ROKANAKO (IRE)
